all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قُمۡ فَأَنذِرۡ

translations.saheeh: Arise and warn
translations.pickthall: Arise and warn!
translations.khattab: Arise and warn ˹all˺
translations.arberry: arise, and warn!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ

translations.saheeh: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
translations.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
translations.khattab: I do swear by the Day of Judgment
translations.arberry: No! I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ

translations.saheeh: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
translations.pickthall: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
translations.khattab: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
translations.arberry: asking, 'When shall be the Day of Resurrection?'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفࣰّ اۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
translations.pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
translations.khattab: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in ranks they shall speak not, save him to whom the All-merciful has given leave, and who speaks aright.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ

translations.saheeh: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
translations.pickthall: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
translations.khattab: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires
translations.arberry: But as for him who feared the Station of his Lord and forbade the soul its caprice,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ

translations.saheeh: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
translations.pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
translations.khattab: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way
translations.arberry: for whosoever of you who would go straight;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
translations.pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
translations.khattab: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: a day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of all Being?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
translations.pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature
translations.khattab: Indeed, We created humans in the best form
translations.arberry: We indeed created Man in the fairest stature

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبࣱ قَيِّمَةࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Within which are correct writings.
translations.pickthall: Containing correct scriptures.
translations.khattab: containing upright commandments
translations.arberry: therein true Books.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ

translations.saheeh: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
translations.pickthall: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.
translations.khattab: even though they were only commanded to worship Allah ˹alone˺ with sincere devotion to Him in all uprightness, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. That is the upright Way
translations.arberry: They were commanded only to serve God, making the religion His sincerely, men of pure faith, and to perform the prayer, and pay the alms -- that is the religion of the True.
